Application Data.NAME: Smith's Furniture Emporium
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith's Furniture Emporium specializes in the retail sale of high-quality furniture, including living room sets, bedroom furniture, dining room tables, and office furniture. In addition to our retail operations, we offer professional furniture installation services to ensure that all pieces are set up correctly and efficiently in our customers' homes and businesses. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, and we also provide consultations for custom furniture solutions tailored to meet specific client needs.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In the past five years, we have experienced one minor loss due to water damage from a leaky roof during a heavy rainstorm on March 15, 2022. The cause was identified as a maintenance issue that has since been resolved. The cost to repair the damage amounted to $3,500, and the claim was fully paid, with the matter now closed. No further issues have arisen related to this incident, and we have implemented preventative measures to avoid future occurrences.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system monitored 24/7, full-time security personnel during business hours, and perimeter fencing around the property.
